digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / Gerrit Verified workflow
propositions: Gerrit Verified patchset dispatches saturate the GitHub Actions pool through high job fan-out and burst arrival, not tickets-branch pushes as previously attributed

Current full-route workflow creates up to 24 runner jobs per dispatch (17 base plus up to 7 mutation shards) with a 13-way immediate fan-out after classification, causing 22+ waiting jobs and 873s queue delays during incident peaks

Repository-local queue depth reached 22 jobs during incident-period bursts and 22 jobs in current-shape bursts despite only 15 running concurrently, indicating contention against the Free plan's 20-job organization limit

Four mutually exclusive first-move policy options exist: bundle four preflights into one sequential job and cap mutation matrix at 3 (recommended, reduces peak fan-out to 10 and max simultaneous to 12), coalesce superseded patchsets (low value post-fix 4cbaa19315), move macOS to branch-health schedule (weakens pre-merge coverage), or upgrade organization plan (organizationally costly, leaves 5-job macOS ceiling)
